column3: “The days increased” is rendered “the time was long,” and NASB adds “for” before “twenty years.”
Close to the Hebrew; “your heart” is rendered “your hearts.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB keeps “sons of Israel.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “it” after “heard.”
“Do not keep silent from us from crying out” is rendered “Do not cease to cry … for us.”
“A lamb of milk” is rendered “a suckling lamb,” and “a burnt offering, a whole offering” as “a whole burnt offering.”
“Routed them” is rendered “confused them,” and NASB adds “so that.”
Close to the Hebrew; “until now” is rendered “thus far.”
“As often as year in year” is rendered “annually,” and NASB supplies “on circuit.”
